10x10 demands far more patience in the opening and midgame.
The key is to slowly, methodically strip away every playable move your opponent has.

If I didn't go this far, you'd never run! 
It's almost gate loading time, get out there now!

—Kh, no! Let me go home! 
After putting on that big cool act, this makes me look like an absolute idiot! This is the worst!
Quit babbling nonsense and stand up straight!
Hahaha, my bad. You looked up to me so much, and here I went and shattered the illusion. Ahaha—......... I'm going home.

.........Indeed. I am none other than "dominare", your idolized... 
Wait, that was you? A Trainer from here? ...Are you serious?
Well, obviously! Ever since I was a kid, I've been a brilliant, athletic prodigy! Naturally, I completely crushed my debut race too!
No way I'm going home all I promised was to run the race we are officially closed for business today~~!!
Rulership sounded utterly sulky, but she managed to agree to a match anyway.
Today, of all days, you are going to fulfill your duties as a Tracen Academy student!!
No thanks. Well, good night.

So raw power just triumphs over everything in the end, huh? Haha, how embarrassing... 
I just wanna dig a hooooooole and bury myself in it......... Anyway, I'm heading home...

Come to think of it, during the Debut Selection race, she seemed quite confident before and during the run.
Perhaps she only gets motivated when "the board develops exactly as planned."

Yeah, yeah, I hear you. ...Ah—so, hey.
Just forget about what happened earlier, okay? I had, uh, just woken up, you see.
I do all right. I love seeing my opponent's reaction when I trap them at the endgame with a paradoxical move. I tend to play like that a lot.

What—you're running off again...?! 
Review the race immediately! And right after that, training!
When I desperately told her that I wasn't disillusioned at all, that Domi-san was still my role model, and that I only called because I wanted tactical advice on 10x10—

As she picked up momentum in the game, she grew thoroughly cheerful.
...Perhaps she's the type who turns proactive as long as things are going her way.

Having my invitation curtly rejected, I was left all alone in the voice call room.
Why is she so reluctant to race nowadays...?
The true identity of my revered board game idol "dominare" was none other than the academy's biggest slacker and troublemaker—Rulership!!
However, my eyes are wide open now! Allow me to show you that my brilliant tactics apply just as splendidly to racing.
(Still, a loss like this is negligible. Looking at the lineup, none of them are likely to try a breakaway lead... Yeah, everything's progressing right out of the textbook.)

I even have footage from my school days.
My parents recorded it... I'll let you watch it as a special treat.
I tried showering her with flattery to keep her spirits high while casually steering the conversation toward racing—
Heh, right? The more you run, the more racing forces you to think... It felt just as fascinating as a board game. I was utterly obsessed with solving it—

It seemed she was quite a handful on the emotional side.
...Still, I felt undeniable potential in her running.

Hey, Ruler!! 
—Ugh, seriously... You are so much trouble to look after.........
(If I'm going all in—it's now!)
(Whoa, number 13 is making her move early. Trying to disrupt the flow with a surprise assault? But with this board... I can easily turn it around from the fourth corner!)

Ten moves left, eight, six... 
Ahahaha, this board is mine for the ta————
Huh? Wait, hold on, this... ————I won't make it.

No! You're definitely thinking I look super lame right now too! 
Whatever, I'm quitting alreadyyyyyy!!
Yeah, I especially enjoy playing the Werewolf. Manipulating the flow of conversation and claiming absolute victory is... purely exquisite.

I'm sure she could thrive at the GⅠ level in the Twinkle Series.
She had that great, elastic stride, and a brilliant mind to match.

Normally you'd hit a dead end there, wouldn't you?! 
Nobody told me Number 13 was that well-practiced, come oooon~~!!

A few days have passed since then—and Rulership seems to still be slacking off.
If anything, her determination to barricade herself in her hideout only seems stronger...
Number 13 took 1st place! What an incredible late charge.
Oh no, you don't!
—She's not coming out! What a massive late start!!

Brimming with confidence, Rulership
entered the gate with total composure, and then swiftly――

I try logging into our usual online Reversi game.
—There she is. "dominare" is casually online.

Ruler! Come out already, or else I'll have to forcibly—
Ah?! You little...! Did you seriously put an inside lock on the door...?!
............Just one match.

Aha, a selection race, is it...? Did you enter me without asking?
Isn't that a bit tyrannical, Air Groove-san?

Coming down the final stretch, Rulership unleashes a fierce spurt!
She surges forward with incredible speed, pulling level with the frontrunners in an instant...!
Tch, I got careless...

A dynamic stride, stamina to spare even while taking the outside,
and sustained, powerful acceleration—she's so breathtakingly cool...

The girl in the footage—she had massive strides, gradually accelerating over
a long distance to sweep past everyone from behind with awe-inspiring late-charging power.

Heh... Naturally. Letting your opponent capture plenty of pieces early on,
only to turn the tables in one fell swoop during the endgame—that's standard Reversi strategy.

...A few minutes later, a chat message arrives.
————『You must be totally disillusioned with me.』

It was just a race from when she visited the racing academy, but...
She read her opponents' movements, executed an effective strategy, and swept past them in style!

...She truly possesses magnificent legs. Letting such remarkable
talent go to waste would simply be far too much of a shame.

Well now, the edges are steadily filling up with my pieces.
Meanwhile, your available moves are dwindling fast... Checkmate!
